description: This file declares functions related to creating empty tensor tensors optimized for MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) backend in PyTorch. It includes function prototypes for creating tensors with specific shapes, strides, and device configurations within the at::detail namespace.

methods.name: empty_mps
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized tensor with specified size and optional data type, layout, device, memory pinning, and memory format tailored for MPS.

methods.description: Creates an uninitialized tensor with specified size and tensor options, for MPS.
